economicQuestion: Does a causal instrument-specific weekday/UTC 4-hour-slot conditional mean predict next 1h/4h returns beyond zero and 24h momentum sufficiently to pay pessimistic current-term costs at Pepperstone minimum volumes and contribute to ONE EUR200 native-allocated book without exceeding aggregate sampled drawdown and with system-level HARD21 potential?
distinction: Calendar-time conditional seasonality; no OHLCV pressure factor, IPF1/RCP1 model/forecast/weights/signal reuse, or refit of any frozen hypothesis. Original broker OHLCV and costs only are decoded and authenticated.
sourceReuse: Cryptographically restored ORIGINAL sealed Pepperstone M5 source and separately authenticated broker current-term quote/margin samples; all dates globally exposed. No historical closed-model scoring and no new broker request in first experiment.
feature: Only UTC weekday and fixed four-hour close slot at signal bar end (six slots Mon-Fri); no fitted technical indicator or outcome-derived session exclusion. Lookback for naive momentum uses exact previously observed price 24h earlier.
decisionClock: Any actually observed complete M5 close exactly divisible by 4h at 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC, no synthetic market hours. Any absent clock remains absent, no forward fill.
executionClock: At signal+300000ms, first exact complete next M5 bar close. Missing entry suppresses model fill; never treat signal price as entry.
targets: Future log-price return next observed entry+60/240min at exact clock. No replacement after missing future bar or crossing phase boundaries.

predictor.buckets: symbol x horizon x UTC weekday x 4h slot
predictor.training: Only target labels matured by decision clock. All symbols/buckets mandatory; no selection of calendar winners.
predictor.decision: Side is sign of shrunk conditional mean; no event whose learned expected signed gross is not strictly above adverse all-in costs is offered to native capital selector.

phase.splits: 26 weeks development;13 selection;13 globally exposed audit. No independent holdout.
phase.eligibleWeeks: All 26 complete selection+audit weeks, no outcome exclusion; 21 funded closed round trips at total system level required.

economics.sourceCosts: Current broker-observed development bid/ask + current tariff commissions + hypothetical 0.5x/2x adverse slippage, conservative historical cost envelope; not broker fills.
economics.feePolicy: Use original ex ante cost_context adverseBps for entry/exit; funding exposure known conditionally only to current observed rates, never certified historic.
economics.margin: Minimum broker volumes/notionals/margin from same genuine source, maximum 3 minimum-volume increments only if financed. One capital wallet and existing Native C# selector.
economics.jointRisk: Eight aligned weekly past states, including all existing open positions, intrahorizon downside, peak and margin; future outcomes never affect predecision selector state.
economics.negativeTest: If no candidate clears adverse cost, retain zero native allocations and stop funded scoring. No capacity/HARD21 claims from mere proposal count.
economics.limits: Sampled H1 equity is not global DD; current expected margin is not historical financing; model M5 closes do not establish broker executions.

multiplicity: 12 symbols x 5 weekdays x 6 UTC slots x 2 horizons are all declared, no post-hoc best symbol/bucket/time/horizon, no individual HARD21 gate.
falsification: Report all paired prequential errors versus zero/momentum for development,selection,audit; all admitted/rejected opportunities; each 26 weekly round-trip count; funded EUR NET and adverse scenario if available. If conditional expected EUR is below conservative friction, do not trade solely for frequency.
